subject: APAC1: Incremental driver hotpatch & graceful-eviction window (Nov 16) - customer ops briefing
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: ops@kumo-cloud.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T02:00:00Z
Subject: APAC1: Incremental driver hotpatch & graceful-eviction window (Nov 16) - customer ops briefing

Hi Naoko and team,

Quick heads-up: we have a scheduled, incremental driver hotpatch for the APAC1 region on Nov 16. This is a rolling, per-host driver compatibility update that requires a controlled drain and warm-swap of GPU drivers; our objective is to avoid full node reboots and preserve KV caches where possible.

Planned window
- Start: 2026-11-16 03:00 UTC (12:00 JST)
- End: 2026-11-16 09:00 UTC (18:00 JST)
- Scope: APAC1 (pilot racks first, then broader pool)

Customer impact (expected)
- Short, transient RPC retries during individual host swaps (typically < 10s per affected connection).
- Potential single-digit % latency spikes for in-flight sessions during a host handoff.
- No data plane model evictions expected for pinned dedicated capacity; best-effort KV cache preservation will be used.

What we recommend you do now
- Avoid pushing large batch workloads in the window above.
- If you have pinned dedicated instances, confirm whether you want us to exclude them from the pilot (we can skip specific tenancy ids).
- Test endpoints attached (test-endpoints.csv) contain warm/ok endpoints you can hit during the pilot.

Attachments
- apac1-maintenance-playbook.pdf (step-by-step operator runbook)
- test-endpoints.csv (probe endpoints and expected responses)

We will execute a staged approach: pilot (10% of racks) -> 30% -> 60% -> remaining, with health gates and rollback triggers at each step. If you'd like us to run the pilot outside your preferred window or to exclude specific pools, reply with the tenancy IDs or times.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Regional Ops (APAC)
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T03:18:00Z
Subject: Re: APAC1: Incremental driver hotpatch & graceful-eviction window (Nov 16) - customer ops briefing

Kim,

Couple of operational clarifications to include in the customer thread (I added notes for the runbook):
- We will use a two-stage KV cache preservation step: soft-snapshot then reconnect. If reconnects exceed 45s we'll trigger a per-rack rollback.
- Live model sessions will be signalled with a 503->retry header during handoff; for streaming sessions we will continue the stream via fallback routing where possible.
- For Dedicated customers who explicitly opt-out, we'll tag their tenancy with safe-swap=exclude and ensure no drain touches those hosts.

Attachment: kv-cache-hotpatch-steps.txt contains the exact commands and health-checks we run.

Note: please confirm whether Kumo Cloud wants the pilot limited to non-business hours JST or if they prefer the full window. If they want narrower hours we can shrink the pilot to 02:00-06:00 UTC.

-marcus
From: Naoko Sato <naoko.sato@kumo-cloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T06:02:00Z
Subject: Re: APAC1: Incremental driver hotpatch & graceful-eviction window (Nov 16) - customer ops briefing

Kimberly, Marcus — thanks for the detailed note and the playbook. A couple quick questions from our side:  

1) SLA/maintenance window: our ops team prefers a maintenance window outside 09:00-18:00 JST if possible. Can you confirm the pilot can run 02:00-06:00 UTC instead?
2) Dedicated tenancy: we have two pinned instances (tenancy-7723, tenancy-7724). Please exclude those from the initial pilot; we will opt into the broader rollout later.
3) Post-maintenance validation: we'll need a short healthcheck run (5 minutes) and a signed-off incident note for our auditors.

We will schedule our test probes against the endpoints in test-endpoints.csv and report any anomalies.

—Naoko
Naoko Sato
Head of Platform Operations
Kumo Cloud
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Naoko Sato <naoko.sato@kumo-cloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T15:22:00Z
Subject: Re: APAC1: Incremental driver hotpatch & graceful-eviction window (Nov 16) - customer ops briefing

Thanks Naoko — we can run the pilot 02:00-06:00 UTC and will exclude tenancy-7723 and tenancy-7724 from the pilot.

Plan updates:
- Pilot window adjusted: Nov 16, 02:00-06:00 UTC
- Exclusions applied: tenancy-7723, tenancy-7724 (marked safe-swap=exclude)
- Post-maintenance: we will run a 5-minute customer-directed healthcheck and circulate a short incident note within 2 hours of completion.
- Follow-up: I'll schedule a 30-minute postmortem sync tomorrow (Nov 17) to capture lessons and any regressions; invite will follow.

Link to runbook and postmortem doc: https://drive.redwood.com/ops/apac1/20261116-hotpatch-playbook

If anything changes in your test probes, flag it in the thread and we'll pause the rollout.

Best,
Kimberly
